items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This guy that wrote the music on there... Dr. Jackyll and Mister Funk and all of that stuff... I took all my kids there from the program to be on it too. That’s another reason I did it, because he let me use

ctx.x: That was set up like that. They All Seem to Disappear. This guy that wrote the music on there, he had all that in his mind. But the thing that I loved the most on there is that very first track. It’s so nice. That’s my favorite recording – one of my favorite recordings, ever, because I like the instruments on there and everything. But all of that other stuff, Dr. Jackyll and Mister Funk and all of that stuff, that was some kid stuff. I took all my kids there from the program to be on it too. That’s another reason…
Oh yeah. I left those at home with the – that’s the one I said, well, there’s information on this record jacket – not the jacket, but the sleeve. But I had to protect.
